# Virtual-folder deletion tests keep both Exchange protocol paths local

The virtual-folder hard-delete helper sets PERMANENTLY_DELETE and builds a flagged virtual folder over a real folder. Its EWS and Graph tasks directly check that deleteSelf(null) leaves no virtual child and records no mock-server folder deletions. The landing also delegates virtual rename/deletion to the shared local base and skips virtual compaction candidates, but these added cases do not directly assert rename or compaction. These are exact source and assertion facts; no test, filesystem or network operation was executed.

Scope: Exchange virtual-folder deletion tests.
